character.name: Alice
character.title: Witch, newly woken
character.calling: Late-blooming witch from the south coast
character.origin: A terraced house a few streets from the sea, on England's south coast
character.occupation: Works at the same accountancy firm as Simon
character.look: Dark coat, sensible boots, sparks at her fingertips when she's upset

witchlight.recovery: A night's sleep, or a quiet hour with the cats

powers.name: Point and Wish
powers.description: Point a finger and nudge the world a little: float a key across a room, flick a lock open, light a lamp, tidy a mess. Small things only, and they don't always land quite where she meant.

powers.name: Rhyme Spells
powers.description: Say a little rhyme and point, and it happens: a teacup turns into a mouse, a door that wasn't there is, a nosy stranger forgets what he saw. Bigger wishes need better rhymes, and magic takes the words very literally.

powers.name: Glamour
powers.description: Change her look with a twirl: a new outfit, hair, face, even age, for a scene. Good for slipping into places Alice shouldn't be. It doesn't change her voice.

powers.name: Mirror Sight
powers.description: Look into a reflection at a place (a mirror, a shop window, a puddle full of neon) and glimpse something that happened there within the last day. Clearer with something that belonged to the person she's looking for.

powers.name: Touchstone
powers.description: Hold an object and feel the strongest feeling left on it, and a flash of the last hand that held it.

powers.name: Cat's Eyes
powers.description: Close her eyes and see, for a few minutes, through Saskee's or Suki's. The cats go where Alice can't, and they always find their way back to her.

powers.name: Witch's Sight
powers.description: Since the night Simon vanished, Alice notices what's hidden by magic: glamours, wards, and doors other people walk straight past.

powers.name: Sharp Eye
powers.description: When numbers, times or stories don't add up, Alice feels it before she can say why.

powers.name: Stop the clock
powers.description: Once, when a glass slipped from her hand, it hung in the air for a heartbeat before it fell.

powers.name: Cats who talk back
powers.description: Lately Suki looks at her as if she has a great deal to say.

powers.name: The name that answers
powers.description: Something stirs whenever a stranger says Simon's name.

case.title: The disappearance of Simon
case.summary: Simon, Alice's husband, has vanished from their home without a trace. The police see a man in his forties who walked out. Alice knows better.
questions: Who took Simon, and why him?
Where is Bar Kurage, and why can't anyone find it on a map?

clues.title: Still-warm tea
clues.text: Simon's study: his chair pushed back, his tea still warm, his laptop open. Nothing taken, no sign of a struggle.

clues.title: A line he never typed
clues.text: On Simon's screen, one line repeats down the page in characters Alice can't read. Shaped together, they look like a lantern.

clues.title: A matchbook from nowhere
clues.text: In Simon's coat pocket: a matchbook printed with a jellyfish and 'Bar Kurage, 3rd Canal Street, Yūgure'. No such place exists.

clues.title: The Hoshino file
clues.text: Simon had been staying late at the office with a client's accounts, Hoshino Holdings. He said they 'didn't add up' and wouldn't say more.

people.name: Simon
people.role: Alice's husband, software engineer, early forties
people.notes: Gone from the house without his phone, keys or shoes.

places.name: Home
places.notes: A terraced house near the sea. Where Simon was last seen.

places.name: Bar Kurage
places.notes: 3rd Canal Street, Yūgure, according to the matchbook.

items.name: Hand mirror
items.notes: Her grandmother's, silver-backed. Her favourite for Mirror Sight.

items.name: Simon's reading glasses
items.notes: Something of his to hold when she looks for him.

items.name: Her aunts' spell book
items.notes: Given to her at 19 for the powers that never came. Mostly rhymes, recipes and warnings in the margins.

world.time: Just before eight, the evening Simon vanished

companions.name: Saskee
companions.notes: Bold and nosy. First through any open door.
companions.status: By the back door, staring at the garden wall

companions.name: Suki
companions.notes: Quiet and watchful. Notices everything, trusts no one.
companions.status: By the back door, staring at the garden wall

last_log: The house is too quiet, and the kettle has just boiled on its own.
